{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Only completed orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel and segment
conversion_by_channel_segment = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute raw conversion rates per channel
raw_conv_email = conversion_by_channel_segment['email'].mean()
raw_conv_paid = conversion_by_channel_segment['paid_search'].mean()
raw_diff = raw_conv_email - raw_conv_paid

# Compute segment distribution in each channel
segment_dist = df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(level='channel')

# Use paid_search segment distribution to weight email conversion rates
paid_search_dist = segment_dist['paid_search']
adjusted_email_conv = (conversion_by_channel_segment['email'] * paid_search_dist).sum()
paid_search_conv = conversion_by_channel_segment['paid_search'].mean()
adjusted_diff = adjusted_email_conv - paid_search_conv

# Print all necessary numbers
print(f"Raw conversion rate for email: {raw_conv_email:.6f}")
print(f"Raw conversion rate for paid_search: {raw_conv_paid:.6f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.6f}")
print(f"Adjusted difference (using paid_search segment mix): {adjusted_diff:.6f}")

# Final conclusion
success = "successful" if adjusted_diff > 0 else "not successful"
print(f"The campaign was {success} after adjusting for customer_segment.")"}
